lesson:
Think Backwards 💡◀️

Deepinder Goyal - Zomato Founder

For example na channel ki 1 Lakh Subscribers ravali anukondi.. then akkada nunchi backward think cheyyali. 1 Lakh Subscribers ravali ante first chala views kavali. 100 views ki oka subscriber osthunnadu anukondi.. then 10 Million Views kavali 1 Lakh subs kavali ante. So appudu na target viral videos mida undali. 1 Million views.. or 5 lakh views ala oche laga.. then 1 Lakh subs ochestaru

Zero To One Ideas - Peter Thiel

Eppudu kuda solve avvani problems kosam chudandi. Meeru oka product create cheste first adhi meeku chala useful ga undali. Tarvatha adhi mee friends ki chupisthe vallu danni chusi idhi already undi kada nenu ee product/app use chestunna ani cheppe la mee idea undakudadu. Appati varaku vallaki solve avvani problem ni meeru solve cheste appudu mee idea successful ayye chance peruguddi
source: Zero To One by Peter Thiel

lesson:
Viral Feature 🔥

Starting lo product ki fast ga users theeskoche daniki offers ivvadam, discounts ivvadam, cashbacks, referral incentives.. ila cheyyali..
Almost prathi company chestadi adhi. Jio, Paytm, even Elon Musk kuda X.Com pettinappudu chesadu

More Money = More Ownership Stake💲

Starting lo mee sontha money ekkuva pedithe.. tarvatha investors ochina kuda meeku knchm ekkuva stake untadi. Adey ganuka first nunchi funding midey depend aithe mee stake chala thaggipoddi. But indulo mana situation batti povali. First startup ni just experience, network, kosam treat cheste better. Appudu first startup ni ammesthey oche money tho 2nd startup pettandi then you'll have much stake. Elon Musk adey chesadu. Zip2 ammesthey ochina money ni X.com. danni ammesthey ochina money ni SpaceX & Tesla lo..

Funding Technique💰

Airbnb vallaki funding rakapothe… 

🍱 food packets ammi money earn chesi, 

aa ochina money ni valla startup lo pettaru. 🚀

Zip2 Formula 

First meeku oka chinna success kavali. Aa tarvatha inknchm peddadi. Tarvatha inka peddadi. With each success mee confidence, experience, network, reputation anne petuguthai. Starting lo ne maree pedda impractical target pettukovaddu. Elon Musk starting lo ne SpaceX, Tesla lanti companies pettaledu because hardware chala cost, software cheap. Andukani Zip2, Paypal/X.com

Uniform👔
Daily okate type dress eskune laga uniform okati choose cheskondi. It gives u an identity, saves time, simplifies life. Elon Musk biography lo untadi: 

Musk, wearing leather shoes👞, designer jeans👖, and a black T-shirt👕, which is essentially his work uniform.

Strategic Networking🕸️🌐
Elon Musk biography lo idhi chadavandi:

By this time, Musk had built up a decent network of contacts in the space industry, and he brought the best of them together at a series of salons—sometimes at the Renaissance hotel at the Los Angeles airport and sometimes at the Sheraton hotel in Palo Alto. Musk had no formal business plan for these people to debate. He mostly wanted them to help him develop the mice-to-Mars idea or at least to come up with something comparable..

Space related experts tho massive networking chesadu. Andulo kontha mandi Elon Musk ki help chesaru.

Up The Surface Area🌀 - Sam Altman 

Ekkuva sarlu try chese koddi LUCK peruguddi ani chepthadu. Adhi networking lo aithe - ekkuva mandini meet avvandi. Ekkuva books chadavandi. Give up ivvakunda ekkuva rojulu oka dani mida undandi - appudu luck kuda peruguddi. So Startups aney concept mida mee life lo oka 20 years vadalakunda spend cheyyandi.

Core Skills❤️‍🔥 - Sam Altman 
Resilience - entha intelligence unna, experience unna.. Determination.. Kastalu thattukodam.. ivi core blood of success 
Adaptability - 💧
High Rate of Learning - 📚💻👨🏻‍💻
Creativity - 💡
Familiarity with the tools - 👨🏻‍💻🛠️🪚🗜️🧰

Tom Mueller - Outlier Talent 🩸

Meeru SpaceX chapter chadavandi Elon Musk biography by Ashlee Vance lo.. Elon Musk ki space industry lo successful avochu ani confidence eppudu osthadi ante Tom Mueller aney oka elite aerospace engineer close aina tarvatha. Athanu unte chalu manam cheyyochu aney antha confidence osthadi. So excellent talent find out cheyyali. They are like blood🩸 of the company
source: Elon Musk Biography by Ashlee Vance

lesson:
Action👨🏻‍💻 → Clarity🫵🏻

Action theeskune koddi clarity peruguddi em cheyyali em cheyyakudadu edhi work avuddi edhi work avvadu ani. Asalu Elon Musk first SpaceX petti rockets build cheddam anukoledu. Russia lo rockets koni vatini Mars ki pampe laga oka experiment cheddam anukunnadu. Anthey. But Russia vallu adigina price Elon ki nachaledu, thirigi ochestunappudu flight lo Elon Musk ki idea osthadi. Maname rocket build cheyyochu.. ee materials kavali daniki intha cost avuddi ani.. appudu decide avthadu cheap rockets build chese company pedadam ani. So Day 1 lo idea raledu.
